correct_program:
(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
   (define (offset< a b)
     (if (= (first a) (first b))
         (< (second a) (second b))
         (< (first a) (first b))))
   (define (find-single grid color)
     (first (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) color)) (objects grid 0))))
   (define (markers grid color) (sort (find-color grid color) cell<))
   (define (normalize-offsets offsets)
     (if (empty? offsets)
         (list)
         (let* ((r0 (apply min (map first offsets)))
                (c0 (apply min (map second offsets))))
           (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0))) offsets)
                 offset<))))
   (define (relative-offsets obj anchor)
     (let* ((ar (cond ((= anchor 0) (obj-r1 obj))
                      ((= anchor 1) (obj-r1 obj))
                      ((= anchor 2) (obj-r2 obj))
                      (else (obj-r2 obj))))
            (ac (cond ((= anchor 0) (obj-c1 obj))
                      ((= anchor 1) (obj-c2 obj))
                      ((= anchor 2) (obj-c1 obj))
                      (else (obj-c2 obj)))))
       (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) ar) (- (second p) ac)))
                  (obj-cells obj))
             offset<)))
   (define (crop-cells cells (color 8))
     (if (empty? cells)
         (grid (list 0))
         (paint-cells
          (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (apply max (map first cells))
                              (apply min (map first cells))))
                      (+ 1 (- (apply max (map second cells))
                              (apply min (map second cells))))
                      0)
          (normalize-offsets cells)
          color)))
   (define (component-before? a b)
     (or (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
         (and (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
              (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                  (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                       (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))
   (define header (if (empty? (markers g 7)) 9 7))
   (define a (relative-offsets (find-single g 2) 0))
   (define b (relative-offsets (find-single g 3) 0))
   ;; Stage A: the canonical marker-selected set operation.
   (define cells
     (if (= header 7)
         (filter (lambda (p) (member p b)) a)
         (sort (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p b))) a)
                       (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p a))) b))
               offset<)))
   (define intermediate (crop-cells cells 8))
   ;; Stage B: choose the largest component created by Stage A.  Ties are
   ;; deterministic: row-major top-left component first.
   (define parts (objects intermediate 0))
   (if (empty? parts)
       intermediate
       (crop-cells (obj-cells (first (sort parts component-before?))) 8))))
step_a: normalize the color-2 and color-3 source objects, then use marker 7 to choose intersection or marker absence to choose symmetric difference
step_b: find four-connected components in the Stage-A result, select the unique largest (row-major top-left tie break), and crop/repaint it color 8
why_b_depends_on_a: the candidate components and their sizes do not exist until Stage A creates the intermediate; replacing only Stage A by union changes Stage B's selected component and final output
